thread:
Marina: :warning: FYI - customer acme-corp-prod reported users keeping elevated access after a SCIM group rename. looks like deprovision path didn't remove bindings. putting details here so we can triage.

Jon: Can you paste the SCIM event and any relevant RBAC mapping logs?

Marina: Paste of SCIM PATCH payload we received (redacted):
```
PATCH /Groups/9a3f
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"replace","path":"displayName","value":"eng-org-admins"}
  ]
}
```
Log snippet from provisioning service (trimmed):
```
2026-02-28T14:12:03Z INFO Received SCIM PATCH groupId=9a3f displayName=eng-org-admins
2026-02-28T14:12:03Z DEBUG lookupMappingByDisplayName name=engineering-admins -> no mapping
2026-02-28T14:12:03Z INFO finished PATCH, no deprovision actions queued
2026-02-28T14:12:04Z INFO user alice@example.com still mapped to role super-admin via internal-binding id=bb7c
```

Marina: Short version: our mapping logic currently looks up group -> RBAC role by displayName in the mapping table (legacy), but some customers use externalId as the canonical key. When they renamed the group, we failed to find the mapping so we never enqueued role removal. The role binding persisted because the cleanup path assumes a mapping lookup succeeded.

Sasha: Oof. Did this start after the RBAC refactor last month? I recall we changed the reconciliation order to prefer cache/displayName for perf.

Marina: Yes, changed in commit 2026-01-10 (rbac-refactor-lookup). The fallback to externalId exists but only on full reconcile, not on incremental PATCH handlers.

Jon: Immediate mitigation suggestions?

Kevin: Two quick steps:
1) Hotfix incremental handler to fall back to externalId if displayName lookup misses (small patch, low risk)
2) Run one-off reconcilier for affected orgs to remove stale bindings

Aisha: I'll own the recon script. Need list of affected orgs & binding ids. Marina can you export events where lookupMappingByDisplayName returned no mapping but binding persisted? I can run `reconcile --org acme-corp-prod --by externalId` on staging for validation.

Marina: Yes exporting now. Also found a failing KMS audit entry that masked the externalId in some older role-assign events: 
```
2025-11-12T09:21:45Z KMS:Encrypt metadata: {"role_binding":"bb7c","externalId":"<REDACTED>"}
```
Looks like pre-KMS-field-whitelist we stored externalId in encrypted blob but recent audit tooling doesn't surface it. We may need to decrypt to reconstruct full history.

Sasha: Important for postmortem: this is an access-control vulnerability window where users retained higher privileges. We should consider customer notification and SOC2 Incident classification. @Marina please prod Legal/Security-Compliance about disclosure timeline.

Marina: Noted. Filing an incident ticket now. Quick draft of timeline for the ticket:
- 14:12 UTC: SCIM PATCH group rename received
- 14:12–14:20 UTC: provisioning handler skipped mapping (bug path)
- 14:20–15:00 UTC: internal alerting flagged discrepancy; manual check
- 15:05 UTC: temporary mitigation applied (reconciler run started)

DevOps Bot: deploy:rbac hotfix branch rbac-patch-externalid merged by Kevin. CI passed. :rocket:

Kevin: I'll push the hotfix to prod canary in 10 minutes, then promote if metrics look normal. ETA full roll 45m.

Jon: Post-deploy checks we need:
- validate mapping lookup now uses externalId fallback on PATCH
- run a sampling job across 100 orgs to ensure no other orphans
- KMS-decrypt job on historical blobs for audit completeness

Aisha: I'm on the sampling job. Marina please share export when ready.

Marina: Export done, uploading to secure bucket s3://redwood-sec/incident-1780003456/recon.csv (restricted). Sharing to Aisha and Sasha.

Sasha: After reconciliation & hotfix, propose follow-ups:
- migrate mapping authoritative key to externalId only (deprecate displayName)
- add unit/integration tests for PATCH handler covering rename cases
- add a monitoring rule: if PATCH doesn't find mapping but binding exists -> alert
- update docs on SCIM best-practices for customers to set externalId

Aisha: I'll open a tracking epic and add owners. Assigning: Kevin (hotfix rollout), Marina (export + customer comms), Sasha (postmortem + SOC2 coord), Jon (tests and monitor rule), me (reconcile script)

Marina: I'll ping Legal & CS about customer notification drafts. Thanks everyone. :lock:
